title: The Hodge correction is an actual gradient with paid norm control
statement: Assume EVERY symmetric mean S and EVERY actual periodic scalar Hessian X satisfy Delta_H(S,X)>=c[|S|^2<|X|^2>+<|X|^4>],c>0, with||H_doubleprime(S)||<=C|S|^2. Put B2=2C^2/c+3C/2,B4=108C^4/c^3+9C^2/(4c)+3C/2,K=32,Bz=B4 K^4. For ANY nu>0,mu nu>=max(256B2^2,1024Bz^2) makes P globally QC for ALL means and actual vector gradients. For z=G12-G21,E=-J Hess Delta^-1 z and X=G-E, E is an ACTUAL gradient and X an ACTUAL scalar Hessian;||symE||2<=||z||2,||symE||4<=32||z||4. Directional-Hilbert/Riesz argument supplies conservative L4 constant without unknown sharp Beurling norm. Source strong QC applied ONCE to actual X yields errors -B2|M|^2<z^2>-Bz<z^4>,absorbed by normal quadratic and sextic uniform tangent remainder1/256. This is full variational receiving,not outer moments,tangent-only result,free symmetric laws or assumption ROC implies source QC. Sextic finite-energy receiving is L6. Producer-identified prior art during a NEW ACTIVE continuation:Dal Maso,Fonseca,Leoni and Morini,2003,Higher order quasiconvexity reduces to quasiconvexity,arXiv math/0305138. At the supplied primary abstract statement scope,smooth strictly2-quasiconvex functions with p-growth,p>1,extend from symmetric matrices to classical quasiconvex functions with the SAME growth. The parent says it will use this degree-preserving result as a known tool. This is not independent priority adjudication or a new completed coupled result. It does NOT identify this explicit sextic polynomial,its constants,an ROC-only premise,the all-eta equivalence,or the uncorrected general-U density with that published theorem. Application retains the actual strictness,smoothness and growth hypotheses;no compatible transfer is asserted merely from the shared extension topic. LaterN1496 supplies a separate DEGREE-FOUR coupling-preserving completion of ANY homogeneous quartic F0 under quantified STRONG ACTUAL Hessian-QC of its symmetric restriction. Classical Dal Maso-Fonseca-Leoni-Morini2003 mechanism,Theorem1.1/formula3.8,is explicitly credited. Original normal value/first derivative are retained by correction,with enormous sufficient constants and arbitrary normal means. This does not change the earlier valid sextic theorem,prove a sharp threshold,identify uncorrected general-U QC or establish novelty of the quantitative coupling formulation.
